stem: Of the 250 students in a university's summer program, \(40\%\) study engineering. Of the engineering students, \(30\%\) live in campus housing, and of the other students in the program, \(50\%\) live in campus housing. What percent of all 250 students in the program live in campus housing?
solution: Total in campus housing: \(30 + 75 = 105\), and \(\frac{105}{250} = 0.42\), which is \(42\%\).
verify:
e = Rational(40, 100) * 250
h = Rational(30, 100) * e + Rational(50, 100) * (250 - e)
v = h / 250 * 100
assert v == 42
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == v
